findings.claim: Claus recovery converts H2S produced in gas treating or crude refining into elemental sulfur; a sulfur-bearing crude cargo is not already merchant sulfur.
Venezuela historically built large upgrading/desulfurization capacity: Sincor at Jose started construction in 1998 and was completed by January 2002.
Comparable major sulfur/gas projects take years: Shah original build 2010–2015, startup January 2015 and full capacity July 2015; Qatar 2010 combined upgrade award had a planned 38-month schedule.
findings.confidence: high documented history/announced schedule; not Venezuela forecast

findings.claim: A functioning Venezuelan recovery train with a limited repair bottleneck could restore merchant sulfur sooner than a new plant, but no defensible site-specific recovery duration or exportable volume is established.
Acid leaching helps dissolve target metals from suitable ores. Copper oxide routes and nickel/cobalt HPAL can require sulfuric acid, while other copper processing routes differ.

SMM describes a complementary network that recovers acid from Japanese copper-concentrate processing and uses it in Philippine HPAL operations, as well as transferring sulfur from Japanese nickel processing.
findings.confidence: high operator network description; current spare capacity unknown

findings.claim: Fuel-processing contraction can reduce recovered sulfur, and smelter curtailment can reduce byproduct acid. A replacement supplier sharing the same upstream process or shipping corridor may fail under the same shock.
findings.confidence: high mechanism; no new observed curtailment attributed
